review_summary.executive_summary: Automated Code Review for 'snippet_20261123_132931.py' (Python). Overall Code Health Score: 40.0/100 (Grade F). Identified 4 finding(s): 2 Critical, 2 High, 0 Medium, 0 Low. Verdict: Changes Requested.

critical.title: SQL Injection (SQLi) via Dynamic Query Formatting
critical.description: Dynamic SQL query construction detected using string interpolation, formatting, or concatenation. Untrusted input concatenated directly into query strings allows attackers to bypass authentication, extract database contents, or modify data.
critical.potential_impact: Allows arbitrary SQL execution. An attacker could enter `' OR '1'='1` to bypass authentication or execute `UNION SELECT` to exfiltrate private credentials.
critical.suggested_remediation: Use parameterized queries with bound placeholders (%s or ?), or leverage an ORM.

critical.title: OS Command Injection via Shell Execution
critical.description: Execution of operating system shell commands using os.system() or subprocess with shell=True. If user-controlled input reaches the command string, arbitrary system commands can be executed.
critical.potential_impact: Attackers can chain shell metacharacters (;, |, &&, `) to execute arbitrary commands with application privileges, leading to full server compromise.
critical.suggested_remediation: Pass command arguments as a list of strings and set shell=False, or use native Python libraries.

high.title: Hardcoded API Key / Secret Token
high.description: Hardcoded credential or sensitive secret detected. Credentials should never be stored directly in source code or committed to version control.
high.potential_impact: Hardcoding authentication secrets into repositories permits anyone with read access to compromise accounts.
high.suggested_remediation: Extract the secret into an environment variable or secure vault (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).

high.title: Hardcoded Database or Account Password
high.description: Hardcoded credential or sensitive secret detected. Credentials should never be stored directly in source code or committed to version control.
high.potential_impact: Plaintext passwords in source code expose backend databases to unauthorized access.
high.suggested_remediation: Extract the secret into an environment variable or secure vault (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Dynamic string concatenation allows unauthorized database access or extraction.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Replace query string formatting with bound parameter placeholders (%s, ?).

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Shell execution permits arbitrary host system takeover via untrusted input.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Use safe process execution with argument vectors and shell=False.

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Hardcoded secrets in source control expose accounts to unauthorized compromise.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Store credentials in environment variables or an enterprise secrets vault.

final_review_summary: Review concluded with status Changes Requested. The target artifact contains 2 critical and 2 high severity security issues requiring immediate remediation.
